transcript: If you were a fan of cats the Jellicle Ball or were sad that you missed it, it seems like we might finally be getting another production. This website has popped up, cats the Jellicle ball dot com, where you can input an email to learn more information about the show's next steps. Now, I don't know if this is going to be Broadway, another off Broadway run, but I'm very glad to see that this is coming back, because this was one of my favorite shows of last year. The way that they were able to blend the worlds of ballroom and the musical cats, I thought was absolutely brilliant. It was one of the most fun nights I've ever had at a theater. And as someone who is not a fan of cats the musical traditionally, this production kind of fixed it for me. And these are my favorite kind of revivals, the ones that take a show that you already know and do something completely different with it and make you see that show in a whole new light. So I would absolutely love to see this come to Broadway so it can be seen by a larger audience. Also, I'm not saying this is entirely thanks to me, but I am saying that last night I did get a cat, and I have been singing Jellicle songs for Jellicle Cats at her pretty much non stop since I got her. So in a weird way, I Feel like I manifested this into existence
